title: STEAMED LEMON PUDDING
preamble:
All Englishmen have nostalgic memories of hot puddings, especially the Steamed Lemon pudding, which nobody can make like Grandmother used to.
Ingredients:-
4
tbsp. sugar
100
grams butter - softened
3
eggs
1
cup sifted all purpose flour
1/4
tsp. salt
1/2
tsp. baking powder
Grated
rind & juice of 2 lemons

All Englishmen have nostalgic memories of hot puddings, especially the Steamed Lemon pudding, which nobody can make like Grandmother used to.

Grated

Method:-
Beat together the butter and sugar until light and creamy.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
Fold in flour, salt, baking powder, lemon rind and juice.
Place in buttered 4 cup bowl.
Cover the bowl with aluminum foil and place in a steamer.
Steam the pudding over boiling water on top of the stove for 1¼ hours.
Lemon Mixture.
Cook three tablespoons lemon juice, grated rind one lemon, and one-fourth cup butter two minutes.
Add one cup sugar and three eggs slightly beaten; cook until mixture thickens, cool and serve.
